strings.meta.title: pdff — Sdukkel, beddel u beddel PDF, Word, Excel baṭel
strings.meta.description: Afeckir n zun di tewurt i usdukkel, abeddel, azizzel, azarri d tallelt n yifuyla-inek PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint d tugniwin. Ur d-ssefra ara tira, ifuyla ttwaksen di tallit.

strings.seo.why[0].text: Ulac tiɣimit, ulac takart n ukredit, ulac azamul n wudem i yettwacanen i yifuyla-inek.

strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, tugniwin, EPUB… seg uselkim neɣ tiliɣrit.
strings.seo.faq[0].q: Asɛeddi n pdff baṭel s tideț?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ih. Yal afecku baṭel, war azamul n wudem neɣ kra yettwaqnen s tiɣimit. Ulac takart n ukredit i d-yettwasutren.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Ala. Ur d-ssefra ara tira, ulac tansa n imayl: tesseqdaceḍ ifecka imir kan.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Ala. Ifuyla-inek ttwaseqdacen kan i twuri i d-tessutreḍ, sin akin ttwaksen. Ur ten-yeqqeṛ yiwen ur ten-yettazal.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ih. pdff yeddu di yiberrani n yal tiliɣrit, tabdart neɣ aselkim (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), war ma tessebddεeḍ kra.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, tugniwin (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML d wiyiḍ.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Tzemreḍ ad tessefrekeḍ ar {files} n yifuyla i tikkelt, d ufaylu i d-yettwassenulfan zemren ad sɛun ar {pages} n isebtar.
strings.privacy.title: Tinfekiyin
strings.privacy.description: Amek i d-yessufuy pdff ifuyla-inek: ulac amiḍan, ulac afaylu i d-yettwaḥarzen, ulac adellel neɣ azuzzel n isefka.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff yettwabna akken ifuyla-inek ad qqimen d inek. Atan, s wawalen n yal ass, ayen i yedrun mi tesseqdaceḍ.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Ifuyla-inek
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ttwaznen s tbaḍnit (HTTPS), ttwasefreken s uwurman, sin akin ttwaksen akken kan ara yewjed uyennan. Ifuyla imeqqranen tteddun s usagen n wakud s yisem n wawal d ttwaksen akken kan ara kfu usefrek; asizdeg awurman ikkes ayen yezmer ad d-yeqqim deg 24 n tsaɛtin.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Ulac amiḍan, ulac isefka n wudem
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff ur d-isuter ara tira, ulac tansa n imayl neɣ takart n ukredit. Ifuyla-inek ur ttwaryen ara, ur ttwazrawen ara, ur ttwazzanen ara neɣ ur ttwaseqdacen ara i usileɣ n tussna tasnawt.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Asikel n tarrayt
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Nettasiḍen tirziwin war isem d war ikukiyen (Vercel Web Analytics) akken ad nisin anwi ifecka i iɛawnen. Ulac adellel, ulac asurrif gar ismel.
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Akuki yiwen, ixeddmen s yiwen n ufran: yettmekta-d tutlayt i d-tferneḍ.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Asagen
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Asmel yettwasagen s Vercel ɣef yisagen di Paris; abeddel n Word, Excel d PowerPoint yettwasefrek s Render di Frankfurt. Isagen-agi ttwaseqdacen ifuyla kan i tallunt n ubeddel.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Nul
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Asteqsi neɣ awennit? Nadi-d seg usebter n wahil:
